record.question: What is the punishment for giving false information with intent to cause a public servant to use their power to the injury of another person under Section 182 of the IPC?
options: Imprisonment for a term which may extend to three months, or with fine which may extend to one thousand rupees, or with both.
Imprisonment for a term which may extend to six months, or with fine which may extend to five hundred rupees, or with both.
Imprisonment for a term which may extend to one year, or with fine which may extend to one thousand rupees, or with both.
Imprisonment for a term which may extend to six months, or with fine which may extend to one thousand rupees, or with both.
